answer_text: On GSM8K, chain-of-thought prompting barely helps small models but helps large ones a lot. For PaLM 540B accuracy rises from 17.9% with standard prompting to 56.9% with chain of thought, while at 8B it is slightly worse (4.9% vs 4.1%).

components.title: CoT only pays off at large scale (PaLM on GSM8K)
components.reason: Accuracy across three model sizes: a trend with numbers printed in Table 2.

components.title: An emergent ability of scale
components.reason: Names the pattern the chart shows, which the answer does not explain.
components.body: The paper calls this an **emergent ability**: chain of thought *does not positively impact performance* until the model is large enough. The same pattern holds for LaMDA and GPT-3 in Table 2.
